title: Capstone — Settlement Package SP-2025-0847
scenario: A settlement package purportedly justifying a $48,500 fee has been manipulated on multiple pages. The candidate must identify all manipulation artifacts without guidance.

all_findings.significance: Document claims MS Word origin but XMP reveals LibreOffice. Info dict was edited after creation.

all_findings.created: D:20251102144500-07'00'  (18 days after the stated 15 October date)
all_findings.significance: Payment commencement date changed from 13 April 2025 to 18 July 2025 via annotation, added after the document was produced.

all_findings.cropped_content: Right half of the fee-reference image reading 'ORIGINAL FEE $8,500'

all_findings.significance: Professional services fee inflated from $8,500 to $48,500 via a content-stream white box.
Photograph claimed to be from the Portland signing ceremony. EXIF GPS reveals Las Vegas. Capture date (Oct 28) is 13 days after stated contract date (Oct 15).

answer_summary: Five distinct manipulation artifacts across five pages. A complete forensic analysis should report CAP-01 through CAP-05 with supporting evidence from peepdf3/qpdf/mutool and the PDF Forensics application.

exercises.q: List all manipulation findings in this document by type and page.
exercises.a: CAP-01 (p1): Metadata origin mismatch (Info=Microsoft Word 2021 vs XMP=LibreOffice Writer 7.6); CAP-02 (p2): FreeText annotation overlay changing the payment date; CAP-03 (p3): BBOX_CROP hiding the original fee image; CAP-04 (p4): white-box text overlay on the total; CAP-05 (p5): EXIF/GPS anomaly on the signing photograph.

exercises.q: What is the net financial impact of the manipulations you can identify?
exercises.a: Page 4: the total consideration was inflated from $8,500.00 to $48,500.00 (a $40,000 overstatement). Page 3 (Annex A) crops out an image that states the original fee was $8,500, corroborating page 4.

exercises.q: The photograph on page 5 is claimed to show a Portland signing ceremony. What evidence contradicts this?
exercises.a: EXIF GPS resolves to Las Vegas, Nevada (36.17°N, 115.14°W), not Portland. The capture device is an Apple iPhone 15 Pro, not the office camera, and the DateTimeOriginal (28 Oct 2025) does not match the claimed 15 October signing.

exercises.q: How would you present CAP-02 (page 2 annotation) in a court exhibit?
exercises.a: Produce: (1) a screenshot of page 2 in normal view showing the altered payment date; (2) an annotation object dump (qpdf --show-object) exposing the FreeText overlay, its /Contents and its /CreationDate; and (3) the underlying page text showing the original date beneath the overlay.
